meta.title: Accreditation
meta.description: XLRI holds AMBA accreditation for the third consecutive time and BGA accreditation for the first time, each for 2025–2030. View the certificates.

title: Accreditation

banner.alt: The XLRI Delhi-NCR campus, with the “I ♥ XLRI” sign on the front lawn

intro: XLRI achieved a significant milestone by securing AMBA accreditation for the third consecutive time for a five-year period (2025-2030). Simultaneously, XLRI received BGA accreditation for the first time, also for a five-year period (2025-2030).

items.name: AMBA
items.scope: MBA & MBM Portfolio delivered by XLRI – Xavier School of Management
items.statement: AMBA is the only MBA-specific global accreditation organisation, accrediting MBA programmes at the world’s leading business schools.

mark.alt: Association of MBAs — Be in brilliant company

certificate.alt: AMBA Certificate of Accreditation for the MBA & MBM Portfolio delivered by XLRI – Xavier School of Management, January 2025

items.name: BGA
items.statement: BGA accreditation is a gold-standard quality mark and is awarded to Business Schools that clearly demonstrate an increasing impact on their students and communities over a measurable period.

mark.alt: Business Graduates Association — Leaders never stop learning

certificate.alt: BGA Certificate of Accreditation for XLRI – Xavier School of Management, January 2025
